typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Account as string,
		StrikePrice as string,
		PutCallIndicator as string,
		Quantity as string,
		Cusip as string,
		Description as string,
		Exchange as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Trade Price} as string,
		Symbol as string,
		{PnL Indicator} as string,
		{Last Trade Date} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCodeLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MonthCodeLookuponCusipLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MonthCodeLookuponDescriptionLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Key as string,
		Value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OverridePromptLookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource split(PnL Indicator == 'T' && notConvertedectfunctiondatedatediff('dd', toString(Trade Date), currentTimestamp()) == 0, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(PnLequalsTandTradeDateisToday,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@PnLequalsTandTradeDateisToday derive(BuySell = iif(toString(Quantity) > 0, 'Buy', 'Sell'),
		CusipContainsSlash = iif(locate('/', Cusip, 1) != 0, true(), false()),
		Cusip4thAnd5thChars = substring(toString(Cusip), toInteger(4), toInteger(2)),
		Cusip3rdCharacter = substring(toString(Cusip), toInteger(3), toInteger(1)),
		Description5thAnd6thChars = substring(toString(Description), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)),
		Description1stThrough3rdChars = substring(toString(Description), toInteger(1), toInteger(3)),
		PutCall = substring(toString(PutCallIndicator), toInteger(1), toInteger(1)),
		EndurFutCode = Symbol,
		Exchange = iif(locate('-', Exchange, 1) == 0, Exchange, substring(toString(Exchange), toInteger(1), toInteger(locate('-', Exchange, 1) - 1))),
		{Trade Date} = toString(year(toTimestamp(toString({Trade Date}, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))) + right('0' + toString(month(toTimestamp(toString({Trade Date}, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))), 2) + right('0' + toString(notConvertedectfunctiondateday(toTimestamp(toString({Trade Date}, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))), 2)) ~> DerivedColumns
DerivedColumns derive(ExchangePlusSymbol = Exchange + Symbol) ~> DerivedColumnExchangeSymbol
DerivedColumnExchangeSymbol,MonthCodeLookuponCusipLKPTABLE lookup(Cusip3rdCharacter == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MonthCodeLookuponCusip
MonthCodeLookuponCusip split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> MonthCodeLookuponCusipIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
MonthCodeLookuponCusipIsMatch@NotMatch derive(ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric = 'XX') ~> DerivedColumn
MonthCodeLookuponCusipIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric = Value,
		ExchangePlusSymbol = ExchangePlusSymbol,
		BuySell = BuySell,
		CusipContainsSlash = CusipContainsSlash,
		Cusip4thAnd5thChars = Cusip4thAnd5thChars,
		Cusip3rdCharacter = Cusip3rdCharacter,
		Description5thAnd6thChars = Description5thAnd6thChars,
		Description1stThrough3rdChars = Description1stThrough3rdChars,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		{PnL Indicator} = {PnL Indicator},
		{Trade Date} = {Trade Date},
		Account = Account,
		StrikePrice = StrikePrice,
		PutCallIndicator = PutCallIndicator,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Cusip = Cusip,
		Description = Description,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		{Trade Price} = {Trade Price},
		Symbol = Symbol,
		{Last Trade Date} = {Last Trade Date}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MonthCodeLookuponCusip0
DerivedColumn,MonthCodeLookuponCusip0 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll
UnionAll,MonthCodeLookuponDescriptionLKPTABLE lookup(Description1stThrough3rdChars == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MonthCodeLookuponDescription
MonthCodeLookuponDescription split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> MonthCodeLookuponDescriptionIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
MonthCodeLookuponDescriptionIsMatch@NotMatch derive(ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumericFromDesc = 'XXX') ~> DerivedColumn1
MonthCodeLookuponDescriptionIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumericFromDesc = Value,
		Account = Account,
		StrikePrice = StrikePrice,
		PutCallIndicator = PutCallIndicator,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Cusip = Cusip,
		Description = Description,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		{Trade Date} = {Trade Date},
		{Trade Price} = {Trade Price},
		Symbol = Symbol,
		{PnL Indicator} = {PnL Indicator},
		BuySell = BuySell,
		CusipContainsSlash = CusipContainsSlash,
		Cusip4thAnd5thChars = Cusip4thAnd5thChars,
		Cusip3rdCharacter = Cusip3rdCharacter,
		Description5thAnd6thChars = Description5thAnd6thChars,
		Description1stThrough3rdChars = Description1stThrough3rdChars,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		ExchangePlusSymbol = ExchangePlusSymbol,
		ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric = ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric,
		{Last Trade Date} = {Last Trade Date}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MonthCodeLookuponDescription0
DerivedColumn1,MonthCodeLookuponDescription0 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll1
UnionAll1 derive(ContractYRMTH = iif(CusipContainsSlash == true(), '20' + Description5thAnd6thChars + ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumericFromDesc, '20' + Cusip4thAnd5thChars + ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric)) ~> DerivedColumnContractYRMTH
DerivedColumnContractYRMTH,GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCodeLKPTABLE lookup(ExchangePlusSymbol == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCode
GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCode split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCodeIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCodeIsMatch@NotMatch derive(GMIFutCode = 'Unmapped') ~> DerivedColumn2
GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCodeIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		GMIFutCode = Value,
		ContractYRMTH = ContractYRMTH,
		Account = Account,
		StrikePrice = StrikePrice,
		PutCallIndicator = PutCallIndicator,
		Quantity = Quantity,
		Cusip = Cusip,
		Description = Description,
		Exchange = Exchange,
		{Trade Date} = {Trade Date},
		{Trade Price} = {Trade Price},
		Symbol = Symbol,
		{PnL Indicator} = {PnL Indicator},
		BuySell = BuySell,
		CusipContainsSlash = CusipContainsSlash,
		Cusip4thAnd5thChars = Cusip4thAnd5thChars,
		Cusip3rdCharacter = Cusip3rdCharacter,
		Description5thAnd6thChars = Description5thAnd6thChars,
		Description1stThrough3rdChars = Description1stThrough3rdChars,
		PutCall = PutCall,
		EndurFutCode = EndurFutCode,
		ExchangePlusSymbol = ExchangePlusSymbol,
		ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric = ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumeric,
		ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumericFromDesc = ContractYRMTHCusipMonthCodeNumericFromDesc,
		{Last Trade Date} = {Last Trade Date}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCode0
DerivedColumn2,GMIFCLookuponExchangeforGMIFutCode0 union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll2
UnionAll2 derive(CusipContainsPeriod = iif(locate('.', Cusip, 1) > 0, true(), false()),
		QuantityNumeric = abs(toString(Quantity))) ~> DerivedColumnCusipCusipcontainsdecimalNumericQuantity
DerivedColumnCusipCusipcontainsdecimalNumericQuantity derive(CusipRightOfDecimalIfExists = iif(locate('.', Cusip, 1) > 0, substring(toString(Cusip), toInteger(locate('.', Cusip, 1) + 1), toInteger(length(Cusip) - locate('.', Cusip, 1))), Cusip)) ~> DerivedColumnRightofDecimalinCusipifdecimalexists
DerivedColumnRightofDecimalinCusipifdecimalexists derive(Prompt = iif(CusipContainsSlash == false() && (length(CusipRightOfDecimalIfExists) != length(Cusip)), CusipRightOfDecimalIfExists, '')) ~> DerivedColumnPrompt
DerivedColumnPrompt,OverridePromptLookupLKPTABLE lookup(EndurFutCode == Key,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> OverridePromptLookup
OverridePromptLookup split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> OverridePromptLookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
OverridePromptLookupIsMatch@Match derive(Prompt = '') ~> OverridePrompt
OverridePrompt,OverridePromptLookupIsMatch@NotMatch union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll3
UnionAll3 aggregate(groupBy(Account,BuySell,ContractYRMTH,Description,EndurFutCode,Exchange,GMIFutCode,Prompt,PutCall,StrikePrice,Trade_Date,Trade_Price,Last_Trade_Date),
	{Trade Date} = last(Trade_Date),
		{Trade Price} = last(Trade_Price),
		QuantityNumeric = sum(QuantityNumeric),
		{Last Trade Date} = last(Last_Trade_Date)) ~> Aggregate
Aggregate derive({Trade Price} = toString({Trade Price})) ~> Reformattradeprice
Reformattradeprice sink(input(
		Account as string,
		Description as string,
		StrikePrice as string,
		ContractYRMTH as string,
		GMIFutCode as string,
		Quantity as string,
		BuySell as string,
		TradePrice as string,
		Exchange as string,
		PutCall as string,
		LastTradeDate as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		Prompt as string,
		EndurFutCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Account,
		Description,
		StrikePrice,
		ContractYRMTH,
		GMIFutCode,
		Quantity = QuantityNumeric,
		BuySell,
		TradePrice = {Trade Price},
		Exchange,
		PutCall,
		LastTradeDate = {Last Trade Date},
		TradeDate = {Trade Date},
		Prompt,
		EndurFutCode)) ~> FlatFileDestination
